scientific_integrity: The background sphere case is already covered. The character is proved using sign-twisted combinatorial Alexander duality and a direct independence-complex trace; the accompanying exhaustive check uses the edge complex instead.
scientific_limitations: Specific graph and action on integral homology; quotient conclusion over Q only. No equivariant sphere model, larger-family classification, or historical priority certificate.
title: The integral dihedral character of the Wagner graph's two-matching complex
